text.zombiedoors.config.server_controlle: These settings are controlled by the server. Ask the server owner to change them; your local settings are unchanged.
text.zombiedoors.config.server_unavailab: This server has not sent Zombie Doors settings. Local settings cannot change multiplayer gameplay.
text.zombiedoors.config.reliable_zombie_: Off by default: use vanilla door-breaking eligibility and Hard-difficulty rules. Enable to let every zombie break wooden doors on Easy, Normal, and Hard. Mob Griefing still applies.
text.zombiedoors.config.zombie_door_pose: Minimum time the zombie tends to hold a door position before returning to a less urgent pose.
Base time for gradual door movement between poses. The downward slam animates 75 percent faster so its hit aligns with visible contact.
text.zombiedoors.config.zombie_door_shie: How long a blocked axe hit disables melee/projectile blocking and sunlight protection. Set to 0 to turn disabling off.
Damage a carried door can absorb from blocked frontal melee attacks and projectiles before it breaks.
Base chance for an empty-handed adult zombie to spawn with a wooden door matching its biome. The chance doubles on Hard difficulty.

Allow adult zombies, husks, and zombie villagers to carry wooden doors as melee/projectile shields, sunlight cover, and slow melee weapons. Sun-sensitive carriers seek shade during the day unless a target is close enough to attack.
text.zombiedoors.config.zombie_door_whac: Time between the zombie's slower two-handed door attacks.
Extra block reach added to melee attacks made with a carried door.
advancements.zombiedoors.the_zombies_are: Have your attack blocked by a zombie's door shield
